name: Dragon’s Breath

source.attribution: System Reference Document 5.2.1, Wizards of the Coast LLC; CC BY 4.0.

authored_intent: Touch willing creature; choose Acid/Cold/Fire/Lightning/Poison; recipient Magic action emits 15-foot cone DEX-half damage; higher slots add dice; casting source supplies DC, source and lifetime.

rules.text: You touch one willing creature, and choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison.
Until the spell ends, the target can take a Magic action to exhale a 15-foot Cone.
Each creature in that area makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 3d6 damage of the chosen type on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.
The damage increases by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 2.
